measurement: MPP hardware cycle counter + native VAAPI explicit CPU wait for completion. No optical or synchronized cross-host measurement.

board.completion_counter_source: KMPP mpp_rkvenc2.c rkvenc_isr: register 0x5200 * 4 / current core clock

model_limitations: Per-camera codec estimate subtracts whole two-stream cycle wire occupancy; illustrative conservative serialization accounting, not a measured latency bound.
PyroWave budgets are not measured quality/bitrate/speed. Assumed 0.2ms stages must include relevant upload/dispatch/readback or those costs must be added.
Kernel session IDs are not externally associated with camera IDs. All 121 completion samples per session retained; app consumes 120 AUs.
VAAPI completion includes CPU submission, synchronization and wakeup; it is not a pure GPU timestamp.
Sequential synchronization is diagnostic and may reduce pipeline overlap. Async controls use the same production decoder.
Recorded native streams retain real frames but replay timing is 100fps and dual starts are aligned, not actual camera phase.
4K is synthetic H.264 only; no current-board 4K encode or NVENC/HEVC/AV1 timing is inferred.

earlier_driver_abort_reasons: Unexpected additional in-flight hardware IRQ after frame limit; settings restored, sample count handling corrected.
Wrong result file name when retrieving completed recordings; settings restored, corrected.
